newsitem.title: JAPAN: IHI licenses incinerator know-how to Belgian firm.
newsitem.headline: IHI licenses incinerator know-how to Belgian firm.

text.p: Ishikawajima-Harima Heavy Industries Co Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to license incinerator manufacturing technology to a Belgian engineering firm in a move to enter the European market for environment-related equipment.

The Belgian firm, Drever International SA, will market the incinerators in the 15 member nations of the European Union. Ishikawajima-Harima set up an environmental plant engineering division last year, aiming to double sales in such operations to 200 billion yen in 2000/01.
It also hopes to increase its exports of pollution-control equipment to 20 billion yen per year by the end of March 2001 from the current five billion yen, a company spokesman said.
